|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Master Qui-Gon Jinn, An Old Friend]] (version 2 of 3). The image here is the Players Committee card image re-rendered 1 June 2022 (no E mark). The current text is [[Master Qui-Gon Jinn, An Old Friend (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source.
* '''Original''' ([[Master Qui-Gon Jinn, An Old Friend]]): Virtual Set 16 release; card image first published 3 September 2021<ref name="img-o-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/masterquigonjinnanoldfriend.gif</code> as published 3 September 2021: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/b4a011ace2799d9e188578c4043193ff94a7a06c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/masterquigonjinnanoldfriend.gif holotable commit b4a011a] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="cj-o">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/1a519d514de0c15525458580c14f6b792a14c46a swccg-card-json commit 1a519d514d] (4 September 2021): dating evidence only.</ref>: “While 'communing': You may not deploy Rebels; Jedi Council members are destiny +1; your total power in battles is +1 for each Jedi 'communing'; once per turn, may place a card from hand on Used Pile to draw top card of Force Pile.” No E mark. Margin: “Either Way, You Win”.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC re-rendering of the Virtual Set 16 images; card image published 1 June 2022<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/masterquigonjinnanoldfriend.gif</code> as published 1 June 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/masterquigonjinnanoldfriend.gif holotable commit e8445f0] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “While 'communing': You may not deploy Rebels; Jedi Council members are destiny +1; your total power in battles is +1 for each Jedi 'communing'; once per turn, may place a card from hand on Used Pile to draw top card of Force Pile.” Same game text words as the original; no E mark. The PC published a second, pixel-identical copy of this image on 5 July 2022 (format conversion only, no visible change).<ref name="img-rr7">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/masterquigonjinnanoldfriend.gif</code> as published 5 July 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a41bae9a74e1300c2325f6f584bab72b56ff28fe/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/masterquigonjinnanoldfriend.gif holotable commit a41bae9] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref> '''What changed:''' No change to the game text words. Visible changes on the image: the side copyright line changed from “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” to “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”, the artist credit line was reset (e.g. “ArtStation.com” → “ArtStation” on Grogu), and the game text was re-typeset (new line breaks). A version under Bill's 12 November 2026 ruling (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Master Qui-Gon Jinn, An Old Friend (Errata 2)]]): PC errata of 12 December 2022; card image marked E1 published 12 December 2022, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set16Type.html Virtual Set 16 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E2-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual16-Light/large/masterquigonjinnanoldfriend.gif</code> as published 12 December 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual16-Light/large/masterquigonjinnanoldfriend.gif holotable commit 12d0bca] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="cj-PC-E2">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/f434d313352448d45db14e080230103c086b1276 swccg-card-json commit f434d31335] (12 December 2022): dating evidence only.</ref>: “While 'communing': You may not deploy Jedi (except Jedi Council members) or Rebels; Jedi are destiny +1; your total power in battles is +1 for each Jedi 'communing'; once per turn, may place a card from hand on Used Pile to draw top card of Force Pile.” The PC card data's errata note (errataDate 12 December 2022): “Original card allowed all Jedi to be deployed. Only Jedi Council members got destiny +1.” The card prints “E1”; it is the second change counted here, so its version code is PC-E2. '''What changed:''' “You may not deploy Rebels; Jedi Council members are destiny +1” became “You may not deploy Jedi (except Jedi Council members) or Rebels; Jedi are destiny +1”: the deploy ban now covers Jedi other than Jedi Council members, and the destiny bonus now applies to all Jedi. The rest is unchanged. The card gained the E1 mark (printed).
